categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Les Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: civil aviation air traffic management, urban road traffic management, and urban governance. The company provides integrated command information system solutions focusing on command and control technology, offering products and services such as air traffic control automation systems, airport information systems, low-altitude flight service platforms, urban traffic signal control systems, and comprehensive urban governance platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies based on the OODA (Observation-Orientation-Decision-Action) combat theory, focusing on data processing, situational awareness, simulation evaluation, and command decision-making. It has developed proprietary technologies including multi-source heterogeneous data processing, 4D trajectory prediction, conflict prediction, air-ground coordination, and low-altitude flight collaborative command. Production mainly involves project-based system integration, software development, and customized electronic information systems with some specialized hardware components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies and state-owned enterprises in civil aviation authorities, air traffic control bureaus, airport groups, urban traffic management departments, and urban governance bodies. The company serves domestic markets extensively, with a focus on regions such as East China, North China, Central China, South China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest China. It also targets international markets in Asia-Pacific and Africa, including countries like Kenya, Thailand, and Hong Kong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, covering major regions including East China, North China, Central China, South China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest. It has also expanded its presence internationally, focusing on Asia-Pacific and African markets, with strategic efforts in countries such as Kenya, Thailand, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Les Information Technology Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on system design, software development, system integration, and service operation. It provides comprehensive solutions and products rather than raw materials or basic components, positioning itself as a system-level solution provider in civil aviation, urban traffic, and urban governance sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes sustained R&D investment and technological innovation, focusing on advancing command and control technologies and expanding into emerging areas such as low-altitude economy, vehicle-road-cloud integration, and data element services. It pursues projects related to domestic air traffic control system localization, smart airport systems, low-altitude flight service platforms, intelligent traffic signal control, and urban digital governance. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support its innovation ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated information systems, customized software development, system integration projects, and ongoing operation and maintenance services. The company also earns income from product sales, including specialized hardware, and receives government subsidies and investment income. Its business model is project-driven with a focus on delivering comprehensive solutions to government and enterprise clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in civil aviation air traffic management systems, breaking international monopolies in core air traffic control technologies. It holds a top-tier position in urban road traffic management and urban governance sectors in China. It is recognized as a market leader in air traffic control automation, airport information systems, low-altitude flight services, and urban traffic signal control, with strong competitive advantages in technology, product portfolio, and government project execution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.61 billion, a slight decrease of 3.94% compared to the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 129 million, down 2.31%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 3.8 billion and equity nearing RMB 1.93 billion. R&D investment increased to 9.04% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented strategy focused on innovation. The company has stable cash flow and continues to expand its market presence domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Les Information Technology Co., Ltd. differentiates itself through its comprehensive, domestically developed command and control technology solutions that cover high-altitude, low-altitude, and ground-level air traffic management. It emphasizes autonomous innovation, integration of advanced technologies such as AI and big data, and the ability to provide tailored, end-to-end system solutions. The company’s products support national strategic initiatives like air traffic system localization, smart city governance, and low-altitude economy development, offering customers enhanced safety, efficiency, and intelligent management capabilities.
